parameters.name: AgentVersion
parameters.description: Set this parameter to V2 to route requests to the ROS Agent V2 backend.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: A compatibility field. V2 does not return a paged message array, and the service does not consume this field.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: A compatibility field. V2 does not return a paged message array, and the service does not consume this field.

parameters.name: SessionId
parameters.description: The ID of the session to query. You can query only sessions owned by the current user.
